mapper.sql: id, title, original_filename, source_type, content, content_hash, status, chunk_count, embedding_model, vector_dimension, error_message, created_by, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document( title, original_filename, source_type, content, content_hash, status, chunk_count, created_by ) VALUES (#{title}, #{originalFilename}, #{sourceType}, #{content}, #{contentHash}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_document WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM knowledge_document WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 1, embedding_model = #{embeddingModel}, vector_dimension = #{vectorDimension}, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 3) AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 2, chunk_count = #{chunkCount}, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 3, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_document SET status = 4, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 2, 3) AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE knowledge_document SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 4 AND is_deleted = 0
